rongmei.title: He kanlou meipu nang ta ning tan mak

lines: 1. He! Kanlou meipu nang ta ning tan mak
Akhang rianra muang kum ma zing e,
He! Nang lun gaimei rianra kuak lou mei,
Tingkao gaanphiu gaanc pat dat ro.
He! Ningtan makge ata duang lou o,
Nang rui ham na kallou meipu,
2. Kapma bampui bam rianra ram khou hei,
Patlou rio he kanlou mei pu.
He nang zauzian rui ata zailou o,
Ping pui chang khou tat bam khou hei.
3. Theimei Jordan duidai bam khuan sini,
Nduang lou o he guang jisu le;
He! kachaek namdai chaeng gaimei khou tei,
Neihla lu suan na ti tat ro.
4. Salem namdaih ringh mei thingbang lim khou,
Bumaeng thanmei rui nduang lou o,
Nang rui hamna ai hei kanloumeipu,
Nang ta ning na tingzing ngam mak.
